chain.title: Fire at the bottom of the world
chain.desc: Light a fire on exposed bedrock in the Overworld and wait for the fire-crafting drop. Grains of Infinity are a chance result in this version; no item needs to be thrown into the fire.

chain.title: Prepare the conduit binder
chain.desc: Combine the installed gravel, sand, and clay ingredients into Conduit Binder Composite. This materials branch can begin while you gather grains and workshop components.

chain.title: Fire the binder
chain.desc: Smelt the composite into Conduit Binder. Keep a batch ready for item, fluid, energy, and redstone conduits.

chain.title: Begin alloying on solid fuel
chain.desc: Build a Primitive Alloy Smelter and supply solid fuel. It is the early alloy route, but some alloys still need tagged materials supplied by another mod or a pack recipe.

chain.title: Frames for powered machines
chain.desc: Craft a Void Chassis for the machine workshop. Keep some grains for capacitors and other components instead of spending the whole supply on frames.

chain.title: A mechanical component
chain.desc: Make Iron Gears using the installed recipe. They support the first powered machines and later alloy gears.

chain.title: Prepare the machine capacitor
chain.desc: Craft a Basic Capacitor and install it in compatible machines. Check the machine's capacitor slot when a powered machine does not operate.

chain.title: Find the pack's coal-dust route
chain.desc: Alloy iron, coal dust, and obsidian. In this Ender IO build, the SAG Mill needs dark steel but is the mod's coal-dust source; use another mod's tagged coal dust or a pack-added bootstrap recipe first.

chain.title: Bring grinding into the workshop
chain.desc: Power the SAG Mill and install its required capacitor. Use it for powders and silicon; check recipe yields and grinding-ball effects instead of assuming every input doubles.

chain.title: Produce silicon locally
chain.desc: Use a supported SAG Mill recipe such as clay to produce silicon. Other mods may supply equivalent tagged silicon earlier, but this task detects Ender IO's own item.

chain.title: An alloy for tools and conductors
chain.desc: Alloy copper with silicon. Before the SAG Mill is available, this build needs a compatible silicon source from the pack; inspect the recipe viewer rather than expecting copper alone to work.

chain.title: Configure the conduit room
chain.desc: Use the Yeta Wrench to configure compatible machines and conduit connections. Test its interaction modes on a small setup before rebuilding a busy production line.

chain.title: Switch alloying to energy
chain.desc: Power the Alloy Smelter and install a capacitor. It handles alloy recipes electrically; grinding balls belong in the SAG Mill, not this machine.

chain.title: A local generator option
chain.desc: Burn supported solid fuel for the workshop. Another compatible energy source can power Ender IO machines, so this generator is an optional branch rather than an exclusive power gate.

chain.title: Materials for control signals
chain.desc: Alloy redstone with silicon. Use Redstone Alloy for signal components and conduit controls alongside the energy and item routes.

chain.title: A conductor for the power route
chain.desc: Use the installed alloy recipe to make Conductive Alloy. Keep enough for the energy-conduit run connecting your machines and buffer.

chain.title: Move power through a compact bundle
chain.desc: Connect energy conduits between a source and consumer, then configure connections as needed. Different conduit systems can share block space while keeping their own settings.

chain.title: Energy upgrades begin here
chain.desc: Alloy the gold, glowstone, and redstone ingredients shown by the recipe viewer. Energetic Alloy opens stronger capacitors and advanced machine components.

chain.title: Improve a working machine
chain.desc: Craft a Double-Layer Capacitor and install it in a useful machine. Check the resulting energy demand and speed instead of upgrading consumers that lack input or output capacity.

chain.title: Buffer the workshop's power
chain.desc: Connect a Basic Capacitor Bank and configure its power faces. Additional compatible bank blocks expand the buffer; storage capacity does not replace generation.

chain.title: Gears for advanced machines
chain.desc: Upgrade Iron Gears into Energized Gears. Set them aside for the soul-processing machines rather than making every advanced component at once.

chain.title: An alloy for transport
chain.desc: Alloy iron and ender pearls into Pulsating Alloy. It supports item routing and movement tools without requiring the soul-processing branch.

chain.title: A crystal for travel
chain.desc: Make a Pulsating Crystal from the installed recipe. Use it for Travel Anchors and related utility equipment.

chain.title: Connect two useful destinations
chain.desc: Place Travel Anchors at useful locations and test the supported anchor travel interaction. Expand the route only after the destination and line of sight work as expected.

chain.title: A stronger energized alloy
chain.desc: Alloy Energetic Alloy with an ender pearl. Vibrant Alloy supplies advanced capacitor and soul-machine components.

chain.title: A crystal for advanced soul equipment
chain.desc: Combine an emerald with the required Vibrant Alloy components. Reserve the crystal for a planned machine or soul-binding recipe.

chain.title: Complete the crafted capacitor ladder
chain.desc: Install an Octadic Capacitor in a machine that can use it. Check throughput and energy use under load; loot capacitors and pack changes may offer different behavior.

chain.title: Gold and soul sand
chain.desc: Alloy gold with soul sand for Soularium. This opens a separate branch for capturing, binding, and processing mobs.

chain.title: Frames for soul machinery
chain.desc: Craft an Ensouled Chassis with the installed components. Soul machines also need their specific gears, controllers, and captured entities.

chain.title: Capture a supported creature
chain.desc: Craft a Soul Vial and use it on a supported mob. Keep the required species available for the intended soul-binding recipe; not every entity can be captured.

chain.title: Build the controller workshop
chain.desc: Power the Slice'N'Splice and supply its cutting tools and exact recipe ingredients. This machine produces special controllers used by later soul equipment.

chain.title: A controller for soul machines
chain.desc: Make a Z-Logic Controller with the Slice'N'Splice recipe. Keep the required head, materials, and tools supplied if you automate this branch.

chain.title: Bind a captured soul
chain.desc: Provide the Soul Binder with energy, experience, a filled vial, and the selected recipe's item. Different recipes require different creatures; a random filled vial is not enough.

chain.title: Bring End materials into the workshop
chain.desc: Alloy dark steel with obsidian and end stone. End Steel is a materials branch and does not require completing every soul machine first.

chain.title: Prepare a controlled spawning room
chain.desc: Build the Powered Spawner and follow the broken-spawner binding setup. Provide enough power, space, and a separate collection system for the selected creature.

chain.title: Carry the travel network with you
chain.desc: Make the required Ender Crystal through soul binding, then craft and charge the Staff of Travelling. Test its supported travel modes before relying on a distant jump.

notes: Re-reviewed the installed 6.2.18-beta recipes and item models. Corrected Grains of Infinity to the Overworld bedrock fire recipe with a chance drop and no thrown ingredient. Dark steel requires external tagged coal dust before the first SAG Mill; copper alloy similarly needs external silicon before local milling. Explicitly preserves those limitations instead of inventing bootstrap recipes. Added Slice and Splice/Z-Logic prerequisites, removed the inaccurate Alloy Smelter grinding-ball claim, and separated travel, power, and soul branches.

coverage.scope: Authored branched progression; item and component acquisition objectives, not automatic proof that a factory works.
milestones: Parallel alloy, conduit, and capacitor systems
limits: The JAR alone has coal-dust/dark-steel and early-silicon bootstrap gaps; the pack must provide another tagged source or changed recipe.
Conditional integration conduits are excluded; the guide does not promise complete standalone progression.
Pack scripts, recipe changes, and other Minecraft versions require the installed-pack scan; this guide is not a complete mod manual.
coverage.verification: Local JAR item models and English registry names; selected recipes and bundled manuals checked. Not a new in-game playthrough.
